sample_unit: patients (aggregate cohort statistics used to generate simulated patients)

links.outcome: Currency of evidence underlying AI-generated CMV prophylaxis protocol
links.effect: The AI-generated protocol was evidence-based without hallucination but relied on outdated evidence, with mean +$4740 per-patient cost (P < .01) versus guideline-based and institutional protocols.
links.quote: The AI-generated prophylaxis protocol was evidence-based without hallucination, but this conservative protocol relied on outdated evidence and was associated with significant increases in expected per-patient cost (mean +$4740, P < .01) compared to recent guideline-based and institutional protocols.

unlisted_practices: Using a general-purpose LLM (Copilot) restricted to PubMed-indexed literature to draft antimicrobial stewardship protocols
Using a generative AI tool to perform simulated cost-effectiveness and sensitivity analyses for stewardship programs

screen.reason: Evaluates the feasibility and accuracy of using Microsoft Copilot (generative LLM) to design an antimicrobial stewardship protocol and conduct healthcare economic modeling on simulated patient data.
